vLLM_prefill_sharing_credit_is_VOID.claim_voided: that vLLM SamplingParams(n=N) shares the prefill, so best-of-N generation should be charged prefill_share + N*decode_share
vLLM_prefill_sharing_credit_is_VOID.evidence: CODE INSPECTION: in vLLM V1, SamplingParams(n=N) is NOT a post-prefill fork. vllm/v1/engine/parallel_sampling.py:ParentRequest splits the request into N CHILD REQUESTS each carrying the SAME full prompt with n=1; prefill sharing then depends entirely on automatic prefix caching. V1 is the default in vLLM 0.9.0.1 (vllm/engine/arg_utils.py:991). The N siblings arrive simultaneously and 8 x ~327 = ~2.6k tokens is inside the V1 scheduler's token budget, so all N are eligible for the SAME step; a V1 prefix-cache block is only committed after the request that computed it returns, so N siblings scheduled together can each compute the full prefill and each MISS the cache.
vLLM_prefill_sharing_credit_is_VOID.verifier_half_definitely_not_shared: the deployed verifier scores 8 candidates as ONE HF batched forward over 8 FULL prompts. A batch does not reduce FLOPs.
vLLM_prefill_sharing_credit_is_VOID.settling_experiment_never_ran: src/cascade_methods/cost_floor_measure.py --phase vllm records RequestOutput.num_cached_tokens. All four vllm_*.jsonl files under artifacts/_cost_floor_measure/ are ZERO BYTES — both A100s were saturated by sibling attacks. The counter was never captured.
vLLM_prefill_sharing_credit_is_VOID.consequence: cost_floor conventions B and C, and the *_shared_prefill_flopeq columns of openstrong_bestofn, are HYPOTHETICAL and must not headline.

standing_caveats: NOTHING in the final method has ever been executed end-to-end as a live pipeline. It is a CPU re-costing of saved per-sample dumps: escalation is np.where(margin < tau, ok_32B, ok_7B) over recorded per-sample correctness, and latency/energy come from per-leg batch-1 constants. The one genuine live cascade in the repo (ckpts/rt_cascade_cap320.jsonl) belongs to the June MedVLThinker work. Source: results/cascade_methods/docs/current/PROJECT_RETROSPECTIVE_2026-07-29.md section 4.6
The method's thresholds were calibrated against a POOLED objective but the report is now MACRO. A macro-objective refit has not been done (hole 17).
MMMU-Medical is EXCLUDED on contamination grounds. Under macro that exclusion is consequential (MMMU would carry 1/9 = 11.1% of the weight), not cosmetic.

The 7B energy constant 45.8 J is DISPUTED: an independent re-measurement on the same recipe gives 57.0 J (+24.5%). Unresolved. Source: results/cascade_methods/docs/current/COMPREHENSIVE_WRITEUP_2026-08-03.md section 11.2

MACRO CIs cover within-dataset sampling noise only, not dataset-selection noise. The honest companion is the leave-one-cell-out range; PathVQA-open is the load-bearing cell of every vs-reasoning and vs-direct claim.
